heading_path: 8.5  Amendment because of inconsistency with international agreements—opposition practice and procedure
text: The Registrar may: (a) decide the practice and procedure to be followed in an opposition under subsection 83A(4) of the Act; and (b) direct the registered owner of the registered trade mark who made the request for amendment, and a person (an opponent) who filed a notice of opposition, accordingly.
